RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, meaning sex was not a factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male committee might reflect poor institutional diversity practices or violate internal panel composition guidelines, it does not constitute evidence of sex discrimination against you. Raising the panel's gender makeup will appear unfounded and could damage your professional standing.

Instead, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. That feedback will help you understand how the department weighted his industry background against your stronger publication and teaching record, and whether legitimate curricular priorities or other non-gender factors drove their decision.
